tools.description: Night Lantern story assembly in one revisioned transaction: narration segments laid end to end, each shot covering a contiguous segment range so picture follows the voice, optional native-video intro/outro, centered dissolves that keep the total length (native videos get frozen holds so their core stays opaque), music cues ducked by narration, and alpha overlay cards. Returns per-segment timeline offsets for subtitle timing.
